title: Purple Bandhani Chiffon Anarkali Suit Set with Hand-Embroidered Neckline & Dupatta
color_custom: Deep purple bandhani with pink, teal & gold accents
description:
Deep purple, flowing chiffon and the timeless bandhani pattern of Rajasthan. This Anarkali moves beautifully with every step – a full flared silhouette with a soft ruffled hem, sheer churidar sleeves and a V-neckline finished by hand with thread flowers, sequins, tiny mirrors and pearl beads. A matching bandhani chiffon dupatta completes a look made for Diwali nights, sangeet and festive dinners.

✦ The Details
• Flared chiffon Anarkali with a V-neck and hand-embroidered neckline
• Thread embroidery with sequins, mirror work and pearl beads around the neck, with scattered sequins and mirrors on the bodice
• Full-length sheer churidar sleeves, gathered softly at the wrist
• Ruffled, flowing hem – calf length
• Matching cotton pants with an elastic back waist and side pocket
• Bandhani print chiffon dupatta
• 3-piece set: Anarkali, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The Anarkali is light, airy chiffon with a soft cotton lining, so it flows and twirls but is never see-through and stays comfortable on the skin. The pants are cotton for all-day ease. The neckline is embroidered by hand, so tiny variations are part of its handmade character.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit through the bodice with a full flare below. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Gold juttis, pearl studs and a potli bag for Diwali puja. For a sangeet or wedding function, add statement jhumkas, a bindi and drape the dupatta on one shoulder so the embroidered neckline stays visible. Abroad, a black or camel long coat looks stunning over deep purple.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling
